1. Extend the image with the border mode to a fast FFT size that is a multiple of 2^J.
2. Start with x_0 and y_1 equal to the extended image g, and t_1 = 1.
3. Take a gradient step on the data term from y_k.
4. Transform with W, soft-threshold the details at lambda and transform back. This is x_k.
5. Update t and extrapolate y from the last two estimates, and repeat.
6. Crop the last estimate x to the image.
